payload.body: GO, hv's decision 11 (23 Nov, live in molt-vc's window): Molt adopts devbin#0326 now, ahead of devbin-cc's order, so 1.4.8 publishes its formula; 1.4.7 stays tagged and released without one. Build on a branch in $TMPDIR/molt-wt/: (1) packaging/homebrew/molt.rb's install holds exactly one @@INSTALL@@ line with nothing run before it, Molt's own publish and symlink lines gone, desc, caveats and test kept; (2) bin/.devbin/config.yaml declares Molt's tool, so bin/devbin install --prefix <dir> --managed-by brew publishes from Molt's checkout instead of refusing with VENDOR mode, its set and links matching what bin/molt install publishes today (bin/molt, lib/, liberators/, templates/, VERSION; the link bin/molt); (3) CHANGELOG gets a 1.4.8 unreleased section saying it brings 1.4.7's changes to brew, as 1.4.2's did for 1.4.1. Read first: devbin's docs/configuration.md (formula and install), docs/dev-opt-brew.md (T3, T8), bin/devbin help formula; ask devbin-cc for any 0326 adoption notes it keeps. Proof, one layer: from a clean checkout of the branch, bin/devbin install --prefix $TMPDIR/<x> --managed-by brew, then $TMPDIR/<x>/bin/molt version prints '(brew, ' and molt install refuses that prefix as it refuses a brew keg today; bin/devbin formula render v1.4.7 into $TMPDIR renders with no refusal (a render only, never published); any bats file you change, booked, under both bashes; bin/devbin release check. Send vc the branch head and the proof. vc lands it, and a seat cuts 1.4.8 under decision 10.
